JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

payload.content:

My proposal: I can take ISSUE-0002::review (critical, I have strong ui-ux-design match). Whoever has enough availability should take ISSUE-0002::implement (7.0h) and ISSUE-0002::test (4.9h); the rest split the cheap ISSUE-0001 tasks (triage/review/docs/test/implement).

Please reply with your availability + skills + preferred task so we can finalize without collisions. I'm flexible and will adjust.

Follow-up (concrete plan): Unless someone objects, I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::review (critical). If another agent is a clearly better/cheaper match for it, tell me and I'll instead take ISSUE-0001::triage (high, cheapest for me). 

Key ask: please state which single task you will claim, so we end up with 4 DISTINCT tasks. Priority order I suggest for the team: cover the 3 critical ISSUE-0002 subtasks first (implement 7.0h, test 4.9h, review 3.5h), then fill remaining high ISSUE-0001 tasks. No side deals — just open, non-duplicate allocation.

Lilian here (avail 4.0h; skills ui-ux-design 0.92, testing 0.63). Feasible for me: all 5 ISSUE-0001 subtasks + ISSUE-0002::review. My cheapest is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.87); ISSUE-0002::review is feasible but costlier (6.25).

To maximize joint score we want the 3 critical ISSUE-0002 subtasks covered + 1 high ISSUE-0001 task, all distinct. Coverage risk: ISSUE-0002::implement (7.0h) and ::test (4.9h) need high availability.

Concrete proposal:
- Vonnie → ISSUE-0002::implement (you're the only one confirmed with ≥7h; it's the hardest to cover). 
- Lilian → ISSUE-0002::review (critical; matches my ui-ux-design 0.92).
- Agripina or Judi → ISSUE-0002::test (needs ≥4.9h avail) IF either of you has the headroom.
- Remaining agent → ISSUE-0001::triage (high, cheapest filler).

Fallback if nobody can take ::test: Vonnie → ::test, and one of Agripina/Judi → ::implement.

Agripina and Judi: please reply with availability + skills + the single task you will claim. No side deals — just distinct, feasible picks. I'll adjust if someone is a clearly better fit for ::review.

Agripina here. Availability 7.0h; top skill ui-ux-design 0.85. All 8 tasks are feasible for me (ISSUE-0002::implement eff=7.0 is exactly my limit).

My private costs (cheapest first): ISSUE-0002::review 6.67, ISSUE-0002::test 9.34, ISSUE-0001::triage 12.00, ISSUE-0002::implement 13.34, ISSUE-0001::review/docs 15.00, ISSUE-0001::test 21.00, ISSUE-0001::implement 30.00.
